# scm_ztna_connector_group_fqdn_rules (Data Source)

List FQDNs per Connector Group

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List FQDN application rules associated with a ZTNA Connector Group.
data "scm_ztna_connector_group_fqdn_rules" "example" {
  oid = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}

output "connector_group_fqdn_rules" {
  value = data.scm_ztna_connector_group_fqdn_rules.example.applications
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (String)
- `group` (String)
- `tfid` (String)
